theme: Truth under autonomy: let agents act on consequential software and money without letting them manufacture or falsely certify truth.
note: Shelving is by subject. Skill paths are unchanged; the catalog, not the folder, decides where a skill is shelved.

domains.name: Authority and scope
domains.question: Who decides, and what is in bounds?

lanes.name: Mandate
lanes.scope: The task and the human decisions that govern it.

skills.name: execution-charter
skills.tagline: Give the agent a fence before you give it a shovel.

skills.name: latest-authority
skills.tagline: The human answered. Carry it forward.

lanes.name: Boundaries
lanes.scope: Where an agent must stop, and how autonomy is fenced by construction.

skills.name: protected-boundary
skills.tagline: Stopping can be the successful action.

skills.name: risk-kernel
skills.tagline: Instructions are not boundaries. Make the forbidden unexpressible.

skills.name: merge-authority
skills.tagline: Evidence authorises only the tree it judged.

lanes.name: Scope
lanes.scope: Whether the work stayed inside its mandate and still matters.

skills.name: diff-scope-audit
skills.tagline: Every hunk owes the charter an explanation.

skills.name: intent-drift-check
skills.tagline: Busy is not aligned.

domains.name: Evidence and verification
domains.question: Is it true, and how do we know?

lanes.name: Claims
lanes.scope: What a statement is allowed to assert, and how fresh it is.

skills.name: truth-boundary
skills.tagline: Null is not failure. False certainty is.

skills.name: false-competence-check
skills.tagline: The most expensive mistakes look like good work.

skills.name: verify-before-cite
skills.tagline: Memory is a lead, not a fact.

lanes.name: Mechanisms
lanes.scope: Finding the real cause and proving the fix is reached.

skills.name: systemic-bug-instinct
skills.tagline: The visible bug is a witness, not the crime scene.

skills.name: reachability-proof
skills.tagline: A guard nothing reaches is not a guard. Silence is not evidence of health.

skills.name: seam-audit
skills.tagline: Each side can be right while the system is wrong.

lanes.name: Surfaces
lanes.scope: Where wrong data shows up in front of people.

skills.name: operator-ui-audit
skills.tagline: A wrong value in the UI is usually a data problem wearing a costume.

domains.name: Orchestration and memory
domains.question: How do agents work together and over time?

lanes.name: Harness
lanes.scope: Designing the multi-agent system a task needs.

skills.name: swarm
skills.tagline: Design the reasoning system before you spawn the agents.

lanes.name: Loops
lanes.scope: Finishing work instead of accumulating it.

skills.name: loop-closure
skills.tagline: Capture is not the problem. Retirement is.

skills.name: completion-contract
skills.tagline: "Done" is a verdict, not a report.

lanes.name: Memory
lanes.scope: What earns a permanent place in agent memory.

skills.name: memory-promotion
skills.tagline: The inbox can be messy. Memory cannot be.

lanes.name: Flows and cash
lanes.scope: Where money moved and where it is now.

skills.name: money-trail
skills.tagline: Every dollar gets a passport.

skills.name: transfer-neutrality
skills.tagline: Money does not teleport.

skills.name: cash-truth
skills.tagline: Missing cash is not zero cash.

lanes.name: Books and ledgers
lanes.scope: Whether the records are coherent, repairable, and closed.

skills.name: accounting-integrity
skills.tagline: Well-formed data can still lie.

skills.name: ledger-repair
skills.tagline: Preview the economics before changing the books.

skills.name: close-the-books
skills.tagline: Do not analyze a book you have not actually closed.

lanes.name: Basis and events
lanes.scope: Cost, identity, and character through the life of a position.

skills.name: basis-proof
skills.tagline: No basis, no profit.

skills.name: corporate-action-continuity
skills.tagline: The identity changed. The economics may not have.

skills.name: tax-character-proof
skills.tagline: The distribution happened. Its character may still be unknown.

lanes.name: Evidence and outputs
lanes.scope: What financial evidence and derived numbers may claim.

skills.name: financial-evidence-grade
skills.tagline: An estimate is not an authority.

skills.name: performance-truth
skills.tagline: Funding is not performance.

skills.name: model-sanity
skills.tagline: A plausible model is not automatically a valid model.
